Three simple steps to personalized AI learning

Choose Your Subject & Tutor

Select from specialized AI tutors: Omkar for AI & ML, Priya for Biology. Each tutor has unique teaching styles and expertise areas.

Talk or type naturally. Ask questions, request explanations, or work through problems together. Every conversation is saved automatically.

Resume Anytime, Anywhere

Saarthi remembers every session, every question, and your learning progress. Pick up exactly where you left off.

  • Full session history
  • Progress tracking
